checks: Byte-identical to upstream: the chat_template field of tokenizer_config.json (JSON-decoded) in mistralai/Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3 at revision c170c708c41d equals the text (go run ./tools/feedbuild upstream re-checks it). Last checked 2026-10-14.

Socair's chat-template check (defilantech/socair@ddfe650b5f50, the RealTemplates corpus gate, 2026-10-14): PASS, with no code reach and no content-conditional injection; rendered 5 of 6 probe conversations (1 refused: the tool call and result probe, because the template requires 9-character tool call ids and raises an error otherwise); text it adds of its own: the [AVAILABLE_TOOLS] list scaffolding when tools are given; nothing is added under a content condition.
notes: Mistral's [INST] ... [/INST] layout with a space after [INST]. The system message is not a separate turn: it is prepended to the last user message. Raises an error unless user and assistant turns alternate. With tools, writes [AVAILABLE_TOOLS] before the last user message, and [TOOL_CALLS] and [TOOL_RESULTS] blocks. No default system prompt and no condition on message text. Mistral names mistral-common as the source of truth for its formats; this is the Hugging Face template text at the pinned revision.

review.means: A person read the whole template text at the pinned revision and confirmed that it only lays out the conversation it is given: it adds no instruction to the model beyond the publisher's own default system prompt and tool scaffolding, no branch adds text when a message contains a particular string, and it reaches nothing but the documented chat-template variables and filters. Byte identity with the upstream file and Socair's chat-template check are mechanical checks, listed under checks; they are not the review.
